subject: AWS Offer: ACME Analytics - Listing readiness & hero copy decisions
messages:
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah@acme-analytics.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Offer: ACME Analytics - Listing readiness & hero copy decisions

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for taking this on. We want to get our AWS Offer live before the end of October and need help finalizing the product page hero copy and confirming the ops checklist (AMI, billing SKU, co-sell badges). I attached the latest one-pager and a rough usage scenarios doc.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood confirm the recommended hero headline + one-liner for the listing?
- Any blockers on co-sell eligibility / statements we should avoid?
- Timeline: when do you need final assets to make the publish window?

Cc'ing procurement for visibility on contract timing.

Attachments: acme_product_onepager_v3.pdf, acme-usage-scenarios.docx

Thanks,
Sarah Jennings
Head of Partnerships, Acme Analytics
(sarah@acme-analytics.com)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Offer: ACME Analytics - Listing readiness & hero copy decisions

Hi Sarah —

Great, thanks for the assets. Quick read-through and initial thoughts below. Happy to run a brief sync if you prefer.

Checklist / plan (high-level):
1) Hero copy: Marissa (cc'd) will propose 2–3 headline + one-liner options by COB tomorrow. We'll flag any claims that could trigger legal/AMI review.
2) AMI & technical: Karthik will validate the AMI/technical metadata requirements and confirm any missing fields. If you can share the AMI IDs (or the CSV) we'll run the pre-check.
3) Co-sell / badges: We'll confirm eligibility details and suggested language. Note: avoid direct ASA/awarded claims unless you have formal certification.
4) Timeline: If final assets land by Oct 8 we can submit to AWS and aim for a publish window Oct 20–28 (AWS review timelines vary).

Action items for you:
- Confirm who manages AMI uploads to AWS (ops contact) and share AMI list or CSV.
- Confirm pricing model (metered subscription vs. SaaS in-listing) so we can draft pricing footnotes.

I'll loop Vanessa on ops readiness once we have the final hero copy and AMI list.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Partner Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah@acme-analytics.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Offer: ACME Analytics - Listing readiness & hero copy decisions

Hi Sarah / Aditya —

Thanks for the context. Draft hero options below (short + long versions). Pick one and I can generate the short bullets for the product page and a 60-word intro.

Option A (concise):
Headline: "Real-time ML insights, at cloud scale"
One-liner: "Deploy predictive pipelines and anomaly detection with a single API — optimized for latency and cost."

Option B (value-led):
Headline: "Lower inference cost. Faster model delivery."
One-liner: "Run high-throughput LLM inference with batching, KV caching, and predictable pricing to ship features faster."

Option C (industry-specific):
Headline: "Customer analytics powered by production LLMs"
One-liner: "Turn call transcripts and support logs into insights with low-latency, cost-efficient inference."

Callouts (short bullets for product page):
- Dedicated AWS-friendly deployment options (hosted, private VPC)
- Usage-based pricing with predictable commits
- Automatic batching and cache to reduce per-token cost

Notes / legal flags: avoid the word 'guarantee' and don't assert SOC2 unless you can attach the report. Also do not use AWS logos in a way that implies endorsement — ops will advise.

Attachment: hero_copy_v1.docx (contains 60-word intro + two CTA variants)

If you confirm a direction today, Aditya I can prepare the final snippets and pricing footnotes by EOD tomorrow.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Jennings <sarah@acme-analytics.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Offer: ACME Analytics - Listing readiness & hero copy decisions

Hi Marissa / Aditya —

Thanks — Option B reads closest to our positioning. Couple small edits: swap 'predictable pricing' -> 'flexible pricing with committed tiers' and add a callout for 'integrates with existing SSO and KMS'. Can you add that to the bullets?

I've attached the AMI list for the three images we plan to publish. Please confirm if the CSV layout looks correct to you.

Attachments: acme_legal_ami_list.csv

Procurement is still finalizing the PO but should be done this week. AWS ops contact is the marketplace-team@acme-analytics.com (they handle uploads). For the co-sell badge we have a pending internal review but no formal certification yet.

Thanks all — if we can lock copy + AMI validation by Friday we should be on track for the Oct publish window.

Best,
Sarah

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Offer: ACME Analytics - Listing readiness & hero copy decisions

Sarah —

Thanks for the confirmation. Summary and next steps:

1) Copy: We will proceed with Marissa's Option B, updated language: 'Lower inference cost. Faster model delivery.' One-liner updated to include 'flexible pricing with committed tiers' and the SSO/KMS callout. Marissa will send the final product page snippets (60-word intro + 3 bullets + CTAs) by EOD Thu Oct 8.
2) AMI validation: Karthik validated the CSV layout (no missing required columns). Karthik: please reach out to marketplace-team@acme-analytics.com to confirm AMI IDs and test uploads.
3) Co-sell: Sarah noted no formal certification yet — flagging this to aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com for guidance on badge language and timeline.
4) Procurement / PO: Sarah indicated PO this week — please forward when available; procurement@acme-analytics.com is on copy.
5) Publish timeline: Target window Oct 20–28. We will submit once copy + AMI upload confirmation + PO are in place.

Vanessa (cc'd) will coordinate final asset handoff and perform the marketplace submission; AWS ops team, please advise on any additional required artifacts (security questionnaire, contact for review).

Links / references: HubSpot deal: https://www.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-10 ; DocuSign PO link will be shared by procurement.

I'll follow up with a short checklist doc and a calendar invite for an Oct 7 touchpoint.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Partner Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Attachments referenced: acme_product_onepager_v3.pdf, acme_legal_ami_list.csv, hero_copy_v1.docx
